showCommunication.title: Communication & editorial calendar
showCommunication.subtitle: Strategy, calendar, timely moments and publishing — to keep your brand alive every day.

selectProject.title: Select a project
selectProject.body: Choose a project from your list to start generating communication assets.

empty.title: Generate your communication strategy
empty.body: We extract a compact context from your project, pull lightweight trend signals, and produce a structured, editable strategy.

empty.title: Build your editorial calendar
empty.body: We'll produce 4 weeks of content ideas — titles, hooks, formats, channels — so you can pick what to publish. Visuals are only generated on demand.
empty.needStrategy: Generate a strategy first to produce a more relevant calendar.

visual.noneBody: Click “Generate visual” to create one. We search free stock libraries first, then fall back to AI generation.
visual.notRendered: Visual generated but not yet rendered as PNG.
visual.placeholder: Marketing text and concept will appear here after generation.
visual.headline: Headline

empty.title: Keep your brand alive around every occasion
empty.body: National holidays, hiring, company anniversary, seasonal promos… Generate a one-off visual and ready-to-publish content in one click.

moments.createBody: Describe the occasion and Idem generates the visual and publishable content.

fields.occasionPlaceholder: e.g. World Environment Day, a new job opening…
fields.messagePlaceholder: What you want to say for this occasion

moments.loadingSuggestions: Finding relevant occasions for your brand…
moments.noSuggestions: No suggestions right now. Create a free-form moment below.

empty.title: Publish to your networks from Idem
empty.body: Prepare, schedule and publish your visuals and captions to LinkedIn and X. Connect a network first or use assisted publishing.

publishing.readyHint: Your content that already has a visual. Prepare an assisted post on a network.
publishing.noPublishable: Generate a visual first (Calendar or Moments tab) to prepare a post.
publishing.assistedNote: Assisted publishing: Idem copies the caption, downloads the visual and opens the network composer. You finalize the post on the network.
